genomilab.title: GenomiLab Research Desk
genomilab.start_when: Start or continue a patient-authorized, genome-informed investigation in the current Claude, Codex, or other MCP agent conversation.

genomilab.open_workspace.description: Open the current user's GenomiLab workspace in this underlying agent session. Requires a selected, query-ready Active Genome Index and can start the local patient onboarding, approval, and monitoring portal.

genomilab.create_investigation.description: Create a durable GenomiLab investigation for a patient question. The underlying agent continues the conversation and planning; this operation does not start another agent task.

genomilab.inspect_investigation.description: Read the durable current investigation, including the specialist-board milestone projection, approved context, plans, evidence, hypotheses, briefs, refresh state, capability catalog, context-bound brief authoring schema, and next actions. Before renewed private-context authorization, only a structural marker confirms that the board exists; current-session authorization is required for member details.

genomilab.form_specialist_board.description: Record the 2-5 persistent specialist identities that the underlying agent has formed for this investigation. GenomiLab stores monitoring metadata only and never creates, starts, messages, or controls native subagents.

genomilab.report_specialist_progress.description: Record one meaningful status or current-work milestone reported by a native specialist subagent. GenomiLab monitors the assignment and does not poll, message, resume, cancel, or otherwise control the native subagent.

genomilab.record_specialist_report.description: Commit one immutable findings-and-gaps report from an assigned native specialist for the current investigation round. The report is traceable synthesis and is not itself an evidence record or clinical conclusion.

genomilab.prepare_authorization.description: Prepare one exact patient review for the investigation's selected or pinned profile and Active Genome Index scope, plus the current underlying agent destination. The patient approves it in the local portal.

genomilab.record_patient_observations.description: Record additional patient-provided information during the same investigation and prepare one delta authorization when it expands the approved context. Use supersedes_observation_revision_id inside an observation only for a correction.

genomilab.submit_plan.description: Validate and persist the underlying agent's exact GenomiLab capability requests, then accept the plan under the active patient authorization without another plan-review click.

genomilab.execute_request.description: Execute one immutable request from the accepted investigation plan by request ID. Local work runs without repeated approval; an exact external-provider disclosure can pause for patient approval.

genomilab.check_request.description: Read the persisted status of one request from the current accepted plan. Only when that request is still in progress, resume its recorded Genomi or approved public-evidence/Paperclip job without resending job identifiers or parameters; terminal-status checks remain local.

genomilab.submit_brief.description: Validate and publish the exact wire brief advertised by the current authorized investigation. GenomiLab derives modality badges from cited records; a later brief becomes a new immutable version with a structured diff.

genomilab.submit_research_artifact.description: Persist one round-bound host-supplied nonclinical ESM, Proto, or Genomi artifact with explicit method, model, version, input/output digests, and provenance. This write never verifies execution, and the artifact is structurally excluded from evidence, hypotheses, briefs, answer-readiness, the Active Genome Index, and clinician export.

genomilab.verify_sequence_substitution.description: Verify one intended protein substitution against a supplied public reference protein sequence using deterministic local Genomi rules. Persist only sequence digests and normalized descriptors as a round-bound nonclinical research artifact; never store the sequence or treat the result as clinical evidence.

genomilab.run_esm_substitution_analysis.description: Run one bounded local, network-disabled ESM reference-versus-substitution comparison through a configured scientific executor and persist its exact method, model, version, digested inputs, output metrics, provenance, and round link. A connection check is never scientific execution; when no executor is configured this returns unavailable without creating an artifact.

genomilab.run_proto_blinded_experiment_d.description: Run one bounded local, network-disabled Proto blinded experiment-design operation through a configured scientific executor and persist its exact method, model, version, inputs, outputs, provenance, and round link. A Modal environment check is never scientific execution; when no executor is configured this returns unavailable without creating an artifact.

genomilab.list_research_artifacts.description: Read current round-bound nonclinical research artifacts and their fixed use boundaries. These records expose method, model, version, input/output, and provenance but are not evidence, hypothesis support, brief claims, answer-readiness inputs, or clinician-export content.

genomilab.list_research_tools.description: List redacted provider-connection state separately from scientific-operation availability. Paperclip may provide approved search and lookup; Biohub and Modal connection checks never count as ESM or Proto scientific execution.

genomilab.revoke_context.description: Revoke future GenomiLab access to the investigation's private profile and Active Genome Index context. Native agent-task cancellation remains owned by the underlying host.
